archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL MINIMALISM (Command Center)

typography.headings: Barlow Condensed, Outfit, or Space Mono (900/700 weight for tactical athletic/cyber feel)
typography.body: Inter or DM Sans with generous tracking and high contrast
typography.monospace: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro for JSON responses, Cypher queries, tool logs, trace paths, and memory states

colors.primary_accent: #00E5FF (Cyan Neon Pulse for active state & graph highlights)
colors.secondary_accent: #10B981 (Emerald Green for Memory agent & validated paths)
colors.warning_accent: #F59E0B (Amber Gold for Investigator reasoning steps & initial hypotheses)
colors.alert_accent: #EF4444 (Crimson Red for root cause alerts & high severity incidents)

layout_and_grids.strategy: High Density Tactical Bento Grid (Mode B for Multi-Agent Dashboard)
layout_and_grids.header: Sticky Glassmorphic Tactical Command Bar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0D14]/80, live agent state indicators, mock/real FalkorDB toggle, and quick incident presets

sections.name: Incident Query Panel (Hero Input)
sections.style: Tactical dark card with subtle cyber grid texture, quick incident presets (e.g. 'Latency spike on auth-service', 'DB connection drop in us-east-1'), FalkorDB tool indicator, and submit action.

sections.name: Sequential Multi-Agent Execution Pipeline
sections.style: Live 3-step sequence viewer (1. Memory Agent -> 2. Investigator Agent -> 3. Explainer Agent) with pulsing active states, Cypher query preview, and FalkorDB tool execution counters.

sections.name: Multi-Hop Audit Trail & Graph Path Visualizer
sections.style: Interactive step-by-step audit trail visualizer mapping visited nodes, shortest paths (tool_find_shortest_path), tool_execute_cypher raw output, and Explainer step narrative.

sections.name: Session Memory & Root Cause Summary
sections.style: Persistent session memory panel displaying tool_read_session_memory & tool_write_session_memory history, confidence score, and downloadable JSON report.

components_and_surfaces.cards: Layered slate cards with border-slate-800/80, subtle hover glow `hover:border-cyan-500/40`, inner subtle gradient highlights, and no muddy transparency
components_and_surfaces.badge_status: Monospace pill badges with glow drop-shadows (e.g., `bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30`)
components_and_surfaces.buttons: Tactical sharp or pill buttons with high-contrast text, clear active glow, and explicit hover states
components_and_surfaces.json_viewer: Syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy-to-clipboard, collapsible nodes, and raw/formatted toggle for `trace_path` and `memory_updated`
components_and_surfaces.terminal_logs: Live stream dark terminal effect showing tool calls to FalkorDB (`tool_execute_cypher`, `tool_find_shortest_path`, `tool_read_session_memory`, `tool_write_session_memory`)

motion_and_interactions.agent_transitions: Staggered Framer Motion slide-in and pulse glow for active agent execution steps
motion_and_interactions.graph_traversal: Animated line tracer connecting path nodes (Node A -> Edge -> Node B) as the Investigator Agent traverses graph hops
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-lifts (`-translate-y-0.5`), glowing borders (`border-cyan-500/50`), and crisp sound/visual cues
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` with instant state changes fallback

image_urls.description: Server rack glowing lights for subtle dark header background layer with overlay opacity bg-black/80
Dark green tech monitoring display for incident investigation panel banner

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, agent status badges, json tabs, preset chips) MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="incident-query-input"`, `data-testid="submit-query-button"`, `data-testid="agent-status-memory"`, `data-testid="audit-trail-container"`)
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum text contrast over dark slate surfaces. Text on hover must explicitly set color (`hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800`).
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: Focus visible ring (`focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-950`)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the incident orchestration system frontend and backend in strict alignment with this design specification.
Ensure 3 distinct agent displays: Memory Agent (read/write session memory), Investigator Agent (Cypher & shortest path reasoning), Explainer Agent (natural language step-by-step audit trail).
Provide a realistic deterministic mock fallback toggle if FalkorDB MCP server endpoint is offline or unavailable.
Ensure JSON response containing answer, trace_path, visited_nodes, and memory_updated is cleanly displayed alongside the human-readable visual audit trail.
Ensure every key interactive element includes a descriptive `data-testid` attribute for automated verification.
Do NOT use generic light theme or default Vercel white card styles. Maintain dark layered tactical command center theme throughout.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid standard blue gradients or centered light cards. Use high-density tactical dark command center styling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All buttons, inputs, links, agent badges, tabs, and interactive containers MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Never rely on text color inheritance for hover states. Always specify hover:text-* explicitly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with high contrast dark border (border-white/10 or border-cyan-500/20).
